get.description:
Pending pairs not already on one product, impact first by default, keyset-paginated.

Impact is this workspace's context (notes or tags) on either side's product; watchlists,
boards and tests join it when they exist (DEC-263 c).
ponytail: the impact sort computes over every pending row; it is a small queue.

post.description: Accept, reject, merge, split or unlink, as the signed-in user. Skip is the client's own.
Reverse an owner decision with compensating rows; the history only grows (DEC-263 b).

delete.description: Delete the rule and return it as it was; its alerts stay, with a null rule_id.

post.description: Mark the alerts read (the first read time is kept); returns the unread count.

survivor; one already on the board keeps its place and note. An unknown id is a 404.

survivor; one with an open test (Idea, Researching or Testing) is skipped.

Take a product off the board, note and all; one not on it changes nothing. The other
cards keep their order. Returns the board.

Write the card's note, or move it to `position`; the cards then number 0, 1, 2… in
order.
